response.rationale: Both forms correctly express “next week.” “Minggu depan” is normal Indonesian and also occurs in Malaysian Malay; “minggu hadapan” is a standard Malaysian Malay alternative, especially in formal writing. The relation “similar” is accurate. No false-friend contrast is present; the difference is preferential/register-based, not semantic.
